people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel said to all Israel, “Behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over you.
translations.bsb: Then Samuel said to all Israel, “I have listened to your voice in all that you have said to me, and I have set over you a king.
translations.kjv: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.
translations.asv: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.
